children: Prismic Life agreed to reinsure approximately $5B of reserves tied to USD‑denominated Japanese whole life policies originated by Prudential’s affiliates. Prudential’s policyholder obligations remain unchanged, and it will continue to administer the contracts.
Shifts risk and capital from Prudential to Prismic; sizable balance-sheet move.
Covers USD JPN whole life policies
Currency/ALM exposure implicated; affects capital and earnings profiles.
Operational continuity; impact centered on capital and risk, not service.
Signals rapid platform scale; potential earnings base expansion.

This extends Prismic’s recent momentum and deepens its tie-up with Prudential, indicating an ongoing scale-up of third-party reinsurance. A larger catalyst would be disclosure of pricing, capital relief magnitude, or earnings impacts for either party post-close.
